issues.description: [bug-hunt] Dashboard weight card: progress collapses to 0% the moment the user reaches or passes their goal, and the 'Goal reached' state is unreachable. Root cause: src/pages/_components/dashboard/useDashboardData.ts (~line 205) derives goal direction from CURRENT weight vs target (cw > target ? 'lose' : cw < target ? 'gain' : 'maintain') instead of from start vs target - so the instant a lose-goal user drops below target, direction flips to 'gain' and computeWeightProgress returns clamp((cw-start)/delta)=0; landing EXACTLY on target hits the 'maintain' branch which also returns 0 (deviation |cw-start| >> 0.5 tolerance). Repro (lose goal, start 90kg, target 80kg): log 80.4 -> card shows '96% to goal'; log 79.8 -> card shows '0% to goal' with an empty milestone track and no 'Goal reached' chip. Expected: crossing or hitting the goal shows 100% + the 'Goal reached' chip (goalReached gates on overall>=1, which is mathematically unreachable under the current derivation - lose branch requires cw>target so ratio<1 always, and crossing flips to the 0-returning branch). Same flipped direction also feeds the weekly ratio (wpr). Fix: derive direction from start_weight_kg vs target_kg (start>target = lose, start<target = gain), not from current weight.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

fix.description: Root cause: direction derived from current_weight vs target_kg — crossing the lose goal flipped it to gain and zeroed progress. Fix: useDashboardData.ts now derives direction from start_weight_kg vs target_kg (immutable). Dashboard shows 62% for start=75/current=71.9/goal=70; goalReached triggers at >=1 as designed. 12/12 unit tests green (computeWeightProgress + getWeightChangeIndicator) covering both lose/gain goal crossing.

judge.note: Exact root-cause fix per issue spec. Immutable start-vs-target derivation is provably correct. Browser verified 62% progress (correct, unchanged on crossing). gain-goal chip scenario verified by dedicated unit test (getWeightChangeIndicator gain goal weight-up=success). 12/12 tests green. TypeScript 0 errors. No adjacent code touched.

issues.description: [bug-hunt] Weekly weight-change chip colors are inverted for gain-goal users. getWeightChangeIndicator (src/pages/_components/dashboard/dashboard.constants.ts:26) hard-codes lose semantics: change < -0.1 -> green success down-arrow, change > +0.1 -> red destructive up-arrow, regardless of the user's goal. A muscle-gain user who gains 0.5kg this week (exactly on plan) sees a RED 'up' warning chip on the dashboard weight card, while losing weight (bad for their goal) shows GREEN success. Expected: success/destructive mapping follows goal direction (start_weight_kg vs target_kg: start<target = gain goal -> up is success, down is destructive). Rendered in DashboardWeightCard.tsx (~line 100, weekly change pill next to the current weight). Repro: account with target_kg > start_weight_kg and change_this_week_kg = +0.5 -> red destructive arrow.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

fix.description: Root cause: getWeightChangeIndicator used hardcoded lose semantics (down=green, up=red) regardless of goal. Fix: function now takes direction param (default 'lose'); for gain-goal users up=success/green, down=destructive/red. Same direction derivation fix from start_weight_kg vs target_kg (i-20260703-1478 same commit) ensures direction is consistent. 4/4 chip-color unit tests green for both goal types.

judge.note: Complete fix: dashboard.constants.ts getWeightChangeIndicator now takes direction param. useDashboardData.ts passes computed direction to it. Unit tests explicitly assert: gain+up=text-success, gain+down=text-destructive, lose+down=text-success, lose+up=text-destructive. Both lose and gain scenarios now semantically correct.

issues.description: [suggestion] Barbell plate calculator in the live workout screen. Feature: a small plates icon next to the weight (kg) input on each set row in Activity live-workout mode - tap it and a bottom sheet shows the per-side plate breakdown for that weight (e.g. 100kg = bar 20 + 2x[20+15+2.5+2.5]), with a one-time bar-weight picker (20/15/10/7.5/6kg - India gyms mix Olympic and standard bars) remembered in Preferences. Problem: strength athletes do this mental math between every working set while fatigued; a wrong load ruins a set or a PR attempt, and the app already positions itself as a precision tool for dedicated athletes (set logging, rest timer, PR leaderboard, Personal Bests just shipped). Evidence: grep shows zero plate-calc code; every serious lifting app ships one (Strong, Hevy, Jefit, Boostcamp); the QA strength-tier surfaces (set rows with weight_kg inputs in src/pages/Activity.tsx) are exactly where users stare between sets. v1 scope: frontend-only - one PlateCalculatorSheet component (kg denominations 25/20/15/10/5/2.5/1.25 per side, greedy breakdown, unloadable-weight hint showing nearest loadable), icon trigger on the set-row weight field, bar weight stored via @capacitor/preferences. No backend, no schema. Effort: small (~1 component + Activity.tsx wiring, half a day incl. QA capture).
